name: hogar-sol-bingo
description: Bingo Benéfico Fundación Hogar Sol (cliente + servidor)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && node scripts/ensure-env.mjs
scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c red,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
